figures.caption: Fig. 2. Typical single episode for the three methods on the same random geometry. Left: DQN (β = 0.7), action 6 (112◦), Euclidean error 0.50 m. Centre: PTB heuristic, action 16 (338◦), Euclidean error 3.75 m. Right: ITO, action 10 (202◦), Euclidean error 0.31 m. The observer trajectory is colour-coded by leg (blue: leg 1, coloured: leg 2). The open circle marks the target position at the start of leg 1; the black star marks the true target position at the end of leg 2. The CKF posterior at episode end is shown by the covariance ellipse.

Fig. 1. Top-down view of an illustrative scenario. The position of the target (gray) and the observer (blue), at the time of making the decision, are marked by squares □. The observer has 16 options for the maneuver, indicated by the dashed lines. The target continues to move with CV. The posterior obtained by CKF at decision time is plotted in red.
